datasetName: UC Post-Fix 3D Building Mesh Defect Reference Dataset

classes.name: Wall-Stair Material Patch / Shade Cutout
classes.visualSignature: Isolated darker rectangular concrete patch embedded in a uniform light-grey concrete wall right at a stair tread junction.

classes.name: Hairline Needle Sliver / Piercing Triangle
classes.visualSignature: Razor-thin acute triangle jutting horizontally out of a vertical wall face beside stairs (degenerate E5/merge needle sliver).
classes.geometricDetector: zero_piercing_needle_slivers (aspect > 15, altitude < 3.0 in, open edge protruding from planar wall)

classes.name: Diagonal Wall Crackline Tear & Column Crease
classes.visualSignature: Long diagonal hairline crackline strip cutting across a flat concrete wall plus a vertical misaligned crease strip along a column edge.
classes.geometricDetector: outer_facade_zero_cracklines (newly torn EDGE_OPEN seams > 1.0 in on visible walls/facade)

classes.name: Diagonal Missing Half-Quad at Wall-Stair Corner
classes.visualSignature: 45-degree diagonal half-triangle missing from a concrete wall next to stairs revealing dark void behind, plus diagonal split on stair side.
classes.geometricDetector: outer_facade_completeness + interior_visible_retention (7-pt Embree coverage drop + atomic patch integrity)

classes.name: Floor-to-Wall Corner Triangular Void Gap
classes.visualSignature: Dark triangular void gap tucked directly between a stair side, concrete column corner, and beige quartz floor tile.
classes.geometricDetector: stair_and_floor_continuity (walkable floor boundary gap / void raycast)

classes.name: Missing Vertical Wall Half-Triangle Exposing Backing
classes.visualSignature: Large diagonal half of a vertical concrete wall missing next to stairs, exposing stone-mosaic stair backing behind it.
classes.geometricDetector: outer_facade_completeness + interior_visible_retention (7-pt Embree coverage + look-key mismatch)

classes.name: Pillar Base Diagonal Cutout & Back-Wall Strip
classes.visualSignature: Diagonal triangular cutout missing at the base corner of a concrete pillar exposing interior stone/void, plus mismatched vertical strip on far wall.

classes.name: Zebra Diagonal Coplanar Texture Swap
classes.visualSignature: Diagonal alternating white littletiles and dark-green concrete stripes on a single planar louver/corridor wall caused by Embree BVH tie-breaking.

classes.name: Exposed Concrete Floor Island Patch
classes.visualSignature: Small grey concrete wall-cap patch interrupting a continuous beige quartz_block_top walkable floor.
classes.geometricDetector: original_texture_fidelity (upward concrete island bordered by quartz_block_top at same Z)

classes.name: Sawtooth Stair-Sidewall Cracks & Shredded Stair Edges
classes.visualSignature: Missing step corners, tilted/broken mosaic risers, sawtooth notches along stair sidewalls, and jagged spikes along stair undersides.
classes.geometricDetector: stair_and_floor_continuity (stair tread/riser retention >= 99.5% + wall-to-wall seam continuity)

classes.name: Trapped Hollow-Wall Internal Shelf Fins & Shards
classes.visualSignature: Stray horizontal concrete fins or jagged triangular slabs trapped inside sealed ~40 cm double-skin hollow wall cavities.
classes.geometricDetector: navigable_floodfill_reachability (strict room_hits==0, ext_exp==0, 6-axis enclosed structural concrete)

classes.name: Missing Baseboard / Stair-Stringer / Column Return Cutout
classes.visualSignature: Missing triangular cutouts on dark-green baseboards, stair stringers, and narrow column returns caused by over-aggressive cavity pruning.

classes.name: Dead Under-Floor / Floor-Slab Sandwich / Under-Stair Void Trash
classes.visualSignature: Floating shredded stair undersides, stone-wall stubs, and triangles trapped inside 1 m hollow floor-slab sandwiches or sealed under-floor/under-stair voids.
classes.geometricDetector: navigable_floodfill_reachability (0 probes in non-navigable dead plenums)

classes.name: Mid-Wall / Baseboard See-Through Punch-Through Hole
classes.visualSignature: Sharp triangular or trapezoidal see-through holes punched straight through the bottom or middle of an otherwise solid flat wall or baseboard.
classes.geometricDetector: outer_facade_zero_cracklines + interior_visible_retention (solid planar wall interior hole / missing triangle check)

classes.name: Buried Internal Wall / Cap Sawtooth Poke-Through
classes.visualSignature: Internal wall block or reversed/hidden face inside a wall or floor cavity grazing/poking through the walkable floor or wall surface with sawtooth z-bleed teeth.
classes.geometricDetector: zero_flicker_convergence + original_texture_fidelity + buried_wall_cap_purge (non-navigable cavity + near-coplanar <= 0.5in cap clip)
